reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Apricot Blossom Peeling Gel 100mL
reviews.text:
I’ve been using the Beauty of Joseon Apricot Blossom Peeling Gel and really like how gentle it is. It exfoliates without irritating my skin, leaving it soft and smooth after each use.

The texture is lightweight and rolls off dead skin easily, but the effect is quite mild, so don’t expect dramatic results. Overall, it’s great for sensitive skin and for a gentle weekly exfoliation.
reviews.zh:
我一直用緊 Beauty of Joseon 杏花去角質 gel，覺得佢真係好溫和。佢去角質但唔刺激皮膚，每次用完皮膚都變得軟滑。

質地輕盈，容易將死皮推走，但效果比較溫和，唔好期望有戲劇性嘅效果。整體嚟講，敏感肌同每週溫和去角質都好適合用。

reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Apricot Blossom Peeling Gel 100mL
reviews.text: I didn’t know about peeling gels until I saw this one while I was in Korea a couple years ago. This is my fourth repurchase…. If you don’t use face scrubs often, you will immediately notice the difference after the first use.. like me >.< my face was softer, appeared brighter, and even gave me that glass skin glow! I love that it’s super gentle and doesn’t have any physical beads in it. I used to use this about once a week but these days, I use it about once every one and a half to two weeks!
reviews.zh: 幾年前去韓國先識 peeling gel，就係見到呢款。已經係我第四次回購⋯⋯ 如果你平時好少用磨砂膏，第一次用完就會即刻見到分別，好似我咁 >.< 皮膚變得柔軟，望落更亮，甚至有玻璃肌光澤！我好鍾意佢超溫和，仲要完全冇實體磨砂粒。以前我大概一個星期用一次，但依家大概一個半到兩個星期先用一次！

reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Apricot Blossom Peeling Gel 100mL
reviews.text: I had high expectations, I thought it was a peeling product, but it is more of a light exfoliant. I liked it a lot for the first 2 weeks, but then I started getting pimples. I use it once a week, and I am very satisfied, I recommend it.
reviews.zh: 本來期望好高，以為係強效去角質產品，但其實只係溫和嘅去角質。頭兩個星期我好鍾意，但之後就開始爆瘡。我每個星期用一次，覺得好滿意，會推薦。

reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Apricot Blossom Peeling Gel 100mL
reviews.text: Since using this gel once a week, I've noticed that I have not had any blackheads around my nose, and my acne has generally gone down. I used to use a chemical exfoliant from The Ordinary which completely destroyed my skin barrier - this gel removes a layer of grime from my face yet leaves it feeling soft! I've also been occasionally using a sheet mask after
reviews.zh: 自從每個星期用一次呢款 gel 之後，我發覺鼻附近完全冇再出黑頭，暗瘡都整體減少咗。以前我用過 The Ordinary 嘅化學去角質，結果整爛咗我嘅皮膚屏障——呢款 gel 幫我清走面上嘅污垢，但又唔會令皮膚繃緊！之後我間中都會敷多塊 mask。

reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Apricot Blossom Peeling Gel 100mL
reviews.text: I’ve been using the peeling gel for about 4 weeks now (2 times each week) and my skin feels significantly smoother. I also love that my skin doesn’t feel dry after using it. I have sensitive skin and it’s not irritating so I would definitely recommend.
reviews.zh: 我用 peeling gel 大概四個星期（每個星期兩次），皮膚明顯滑咗好多。我都好鍾意用完之後皮膚唔會覺得乾。我係敏感肌，用完都唔刺激，絕對推薦。

reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Apricot Blossom Peeling Gel 100mL
reviews.text: The effect is average, not too obvious, will not buy again
reviews.zh: 效果一般，唔太明顯，唔會再買。

reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Apricot Blossom Peeling Gel 100mL
reviews.text: Was looking for a gentle physical exfoliant, this one is amazing!! It balls up when you rub it in and gently exfoliates, but when I woke up the next morning my face was BABY soft, I couldn't stop touching it. Good if you want overall smoothness, and less irritation.
reviews.zh: 本來想搵一款溫和嘅物理去角質，呢款真係超正！！捽嘅時候會成球成球咁推開，溫和去角質，第二朝起身塊面滑到好似 BB 咁，成日忍唔住摸。如果想整體滑溜啲、減少刺激，就啱用。

reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Apricot Blossom Peeling Gel 100mL
reviews.text: For anyone who struggles with very dry skin and blemishes this is honestly a great gentle exfoliator. It's quick and easy to use and leaves the skin baby soft. It also preps it nicely for makeup if your skin is flaking without irritating anything whatsoever.
reviews.zh: 如果你受極乾肌同暗瘡困擾，呢款真係一款好好嘅溫和去角質。佢用起嚟快又方便，用完皮膚滑到好似 BB 咁。如果皮膚甩皮，佢仲可以幫你打好底再上妝，全程都唔會刺激到任何嘢。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
